method: Self-contained data audit: load the ridge-fit KPI's own fitted_Ygi_comparison array (24 rows, each with published and fitted Y_gi in K.g/mol plus n_train_polymers_with_group). Check sign concordance between fitted and published values (published table is 0/24 negative by publication convention -- Y_gi is a positive additive rigidity/Tg-elevation contribution in this theory). Rank all 24 groups by training support to test whether any sign flips concentrate at low support (the same under-determination mechanism the module's own prior 15-polymer receipt diagnosed). Compute Spearman rank correlation between n_train_polymers_with_group and |ratio_fitted_over_published - 1| across all 24 groups as a mechanism check, using a dependency-free rank implementation.

rights_check: No new data source opened. This audit reads only the already-in-tree, already-signed van-krevelen-ridge-fit-on-1000-polyuniverse-polymers-kpi.v1.json, which stores its own published and fitted Y_gi tables verbatim.
why: 2 of 24 fitted Y_gi coefficients (vinyl_CH2: fitted=-3125.15 vs published=+2000 K.g/mol; nitrile: fitted=-2843.55 vs published=+5500 K.g/mol) are SIGN-REVERSED relative to their published counterparts, in a table where 0/24 published values are negative -- i.e. the receipt's own ground-truth column asserts every one of these 24 groups makes a positive contribution to Tg, and the fitted model contradicts that direction for 2 of them. This is not a magnitude disagreement (which the receipt already discloses and treats as expected calibration drift) -- it is a directional physical contradiction that falsifies the claim that the fit 'confirms the 24-group STRUCTURE is correct.' Both sign-flipped groups sit in the bottom third of training support (vinyl_CH2 rank 7/24, nitrile rank 9/24, ascending by n_train_polymers_with_group), and the Spearman correlation between n_train and |ratio-1| deviation across all 24 groups is -0.523 (moderate negative -- more training support predicts smaller deviation from published), directly reproducing the same under-determination failure mode the module's own prior 15-polymer ridge-retuned receipt diagnosed. The 1000-polymer receipt's claim lock 'prior_ridge_receipt_under_determination_hypothesis_now_resolved' is therefore false for the rare-group coefficients: n=807 total training polymers resolves under-determination for common groups (n_train~800) but not for rare ones (n_train=31, 124), which is exactly where the physically inadmissible signs appear. Additionally, 13/24 (54%) of all fitted coefficients deviate >50% in magnitude from published, further undermining 'Bicerano-quality when properly calibrated' as a structural (not just aggregate-MAE) claim.
